answer: Each node’s reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained honest service. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity and EigenTrust matrix factorization limit borrowed credibility. Fresh sybil identities—whether named harbor, lotus, or sonnet—begin with negligible incoming trust and near-zero eigenvector centrality, and cannot pass consensus until they earn durable, corroborated interactions.
